19: Blackrock Outrunners and Renegades are running ambushes between here and Stonewatch Keep.  The leader of the Outrunners is an orc named Tharil'zun--we want this orc.  Bring me the head of Tharil'zun!
Bring Tharil'zun's Head to Marshal Marris in Redridge.
69: Oh my!  Must have missed this the first time.  In the registry, right beneath the first address for Stalvan there's another one listed, only partially scratched out.  Looks like he was headed to The Lion's Pride Inn over in Goldshire.  Might want to check there, {name}.
Go to The Lion's Pride Inn to see if anyone there has heard of the name Stalvan.
119:
Ok, I'll give him his 50 horseshoes...

Here they are, all boxed up and ready to go!  Tell Verner it was a pleasure doing business, and be sure he reads the note attached to this crate!
Return to Verner Osgood in Redridge.  Give him the Crate of Horseshoes.
169:
Wanted! Gath'Ilzogg, Leader of the Blackrock attacks on Stonewatch Keep and raids against the township of Lakeshire. 

Gath'Ilzogg is extremely dangerous.  He is reportedly holed up in the recently conquered keep plotting the Blackrock clan's further crimes against humanity.  The orc infestation must be quelled at all costs.  A gracious reward will be given to whatever brave soul can deliver the head of Gath'Ilzogg to Magistrate Solomon.
Kill Gath'Ilzogg and bring his head to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire for the reward.
219:
At last, friends of the Alliance!

Help... please... 

The last thing I remember these foul Orcs overpowered our regiment.  Most the men were killed. I took a strong blow to the head and everything went black. Now I am held captive in this cave.  Help me, I am hurt badly.

I'll need help getting back to town... please... you're my last hope...
Protect Corporal Keeshan on the journey back to Redridge.
269:
Go to the city of Stormwind and speak with Bishop Farthing in the Cathedral of Light.  Give him Jitters' journal and tell him you mean to face Morbent Fel.

Although Stormwind has forsaken Darkshire, Farthing is a kind soul and very wise.  He may help you on your quest to save us.

Your mission is perilous, but hurry, {name}.  With each passing hour, the shadows of Duskwood grow ever darker.
Give Jitters' Completed Journal to Bishop Farthing in Stormwind.
319:
I have a cask of Evershine handy, but...can you do me a favor?  Brewnall village could use a hand against the wild animals that wander the nearby snows.  Sometimes they wander close.

We're not afraid of these bears and cats and boars - no self respecting dwarf would be - but if you can take care of those animals for us, then we'd have more time for our crafting and brewing.
Kill 6 Ice Claw Bears, 8 Elder Crag Boars, and 8 Snow Leopards, and then return to Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village.
369:
While you were out gathering, I uncovered some old text in one of my tomes that indicates that an ancient plague wiped out thousands of innocent victims.  Later it was discovered that the deadly agent in the plague was preserved through the venom of Night Web Spiders.

Bring me some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider to complete this experiment.  I want to see if the contagious element from the venom will work with my new concoction.  Rumor has it the spiders can be found in Eastern Tirisfal Glades.
Apothecary Johaan in the town of Brill wants you to bring him 4 samples of venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider.
419:
My friend and fellow Siege Engine pilot, Mori Hildelve, is lost in the hills.  We were looking for a rare ore that's needed for a high-grade blastpowder, and during our search he drove his engine up a steep hill and busted it!

Still convinced that ore was in these mountains, Hildelve charged me to guard our engines while he continued on foot, searching.

It's been days, and I've heard some beastly growls in the hills at night.  Mori's tough as nails, but I'm worried.

Please, {name}.  Find him.
469:
Greetings, traveler!

Don't suppose you might be heading in the direction of Menethil, would you? If you're not, I'd suggest you stop there, it's a good place to purchase goods and even have a pint and relax.

Now, if it just so happens that you're heading in that direction, I don't suppose you'd mind taking this bundle of crocolisk skins to James Halloran, the tanner?

I'd do it myself, but my wife's been in quite a mood lately, and I'd like to put off facing her as long as possible.
Deliver the Bundle of Crocolisk Skins to James Halloran, the tanner, in Menethil Harbor.
519:
Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus are Mug'Thol's lieutenants. They are loyal to him, though who can say what drives an ogre to loyalty.

Bring me their heads, {name}, and then all that will remain is to remove Mug'Thol's head, crown and all.
Kill Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus and bring their heads to Melisara in Tarren Mill.
569:
When we first arrived in this jungle we did not intend to wage war on the local tribes.  Our mission to supply Stonard is of the highest priority.  But complications have arisen.  A local band of ogres has occupied the Mizjah Ruins to the southeast of Grom'gol.  Despite warnings, they continue to ambush our supply caravans.

I am putting you in charge of dealing with these uncooperative ogres.

Travel to the ruins and attempt to drive them from the area.  At the very least it will send a firm message.
Commander Aggro'gosh of the Grom'gol base camp wants you to kill 10 Ogre Brutes and 5 Ogre Witch Doctors.
619:
This is an abandoned lifeboat.  Printed along its side in scratched, faded paint are the words:

"Smotts' Revenge"
669:
Fleet Master Seahorn will want to hear about our find at once.

But as you can see, we're not in much of a position to get out of here. Not only is the tide too low, but those damned creatures we disrupted are keeping a close eye on our movements.

You can be of great service to the Blackwater Raiders if you can get word to Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay that we discovered the treasure and are working on extracting more.  Take him this sample as proof.
Take the Sample Elven Gem to Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay.
719:
Hey, {name}. Be careful 'round here. There be Dark Iron dwarves all around--looked like the Shadowforge clan.

They just attacked the excavation site I was workin' at--killed nearly everyone there, including my boss Hammertoe. I barely escaped with me life.

The site's just to the north of here, and I'm tryin' to plan a way to get some of our supplies back, especially me lucky pick.

Think you'd be up to helpin' me out some? One of those damned Dark Iron must have my pick! Could be anyone of them.
Find Ryedol's Lucky Pick and return it to Prospector Ryedol south of Hammertoe's Dig Site.
769:
The kodo beasts of Mulgore are strong and sturdy -- traits much respected among us.  If you are skilled in leatherworking and wish the knowledge to make a Kodo Hide Bag, then bring me supplies for my trade.

Do this, and I will share my knowledge with you.
Bring 4 Light Leather and 4 Coarse Thread to Veren Tallstrider in Thunder Bluff.
819:
A small placard on one of the ends of the keg says,

"Chen Stormstout-

May your spirit be raised and always raise your spirits."
Find someone who knows about Chen's Empty Keg.
869:
Not long ago, a shipment of silver was stolen from our guard tower.  It was meant as payroll to the Crossroads' guards, and we want that silver back.

The strange thing is... we caught one of the thieves on the night of the theft.  And... it was a raptor!  Unbelievable!

I don't know what raptors would want with silver.  But I don't care -- I want the raptors dead so they won't steal from us again!

Hunt raptors in the Barrens.  Collect for me their heads!
Bring 12 Raptor Heads to Gazrog at the Crossroads.
919:
Small timberlings are sprouting around the waters of Lake Al'Ameth.  I'm afraid these sprouts are beyond help -- we should try to clear them from the land before they grow large enough to cause trouble.

When you're wandering the lake, if you see any timberling sprouts please take them.  Help keep our land clean!
Bring 12 Timberling Sprouts to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
969:
Ah, I can tell just by lookin' at ya -- you be wantin' to make a lucky charm. Mau'ari always knows!

To da south. you'll find a canyon, an' giants made a' solid ice. The giants sometimes be carryin' dem, but ya can always gather da shards yerself from da canyon. These shards have a powerful reflective quality.

Bring back 10 frostmaul shards, and my lucky charm will be yours.
Collect 4 Frostmaul Shards for Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.
1019:
Attention, heroes!

The Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor!  A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.

All interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle.  Speak with the Arch Druid in Darnassus, Fandral Staghelm, for more information!
Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.
1069:
Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay!  The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.

I smell an opportunity!

In Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider.  Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!

In Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.

In Sishir Canyon... well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...
Bring 15 Deepmoss Eggs to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
1119:
I figured out how to use Zanzil's mixture with stout to make a powerful libation.  A Fool's Stout.  I think it'll be just what Kravel needs, but try it out and let me know how it works.

And {name}, don't keep this stuff too long without using it.  Zanzil's mixture has a weird effect on the stout's yeast, kicking it into high gear.  So it won't stay fresh forever.
Bring the Fool's Stout back to Kravel in the Shimmering Flats.
1169:
Whilst that craven fool, Mok'Morokk, wallows in power and Tharg wrestles the demons of sorrow and vengeance and vies for leadership of the clan, I seem to be the only one concerned with identifying the source of aggression on our old home.

Why the puzzled stare, {name}? Expecting me to speak like an uncouth ruffian merely because I am an ogre?

Now back to business, bring to me the hearts and tongues from the whelps and hatchlings. I shall trace the root of this evil...
Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village would like you to bring him 15 Searing Tongues and 15 Searing Hearts.
1219:
Sifting through the loose dirt, the severed hand of an orc is found.  And clutched in the hand is a bone-carved tube.  And in the tube is a dirt-stained parchment.

The parchment is written in orcish... and it looks important.
Bring the Spy's Report to a Theramore Lieutenant.
1269:
A glint of light on the ground catches your eye from underneath the rubble. Brushing debris and ash caked onto the object reveals the insignia of a gold anchor on white, enameled on the surface: the sign of Theramore.

Underneath the anchor is embossed the name "Lieutenant Paval Reethe".
Bring Reethe's Badge to Krog in Brackenwall Village.
1319:
I'm sorry I can't be of much help, {name}, but I can refer you to someone who would be. Caz Twosprocket, one of our best blacksmiths, works the forge at the smithy.

Take the shield to him, and see what he can tell you.
Show the Blackened Iron Shield to Caz Twosprocket in Theramore.
1369:
The Gelkis think our centaur mother, Theradras, protects us.  They are stupid.  No one protects the centaur.  The Magram do not need protection!  We are the strongest!

Show the Gelkis they are stupid.  Go to the cave in their village.  They hoard crystals in that cave, the tears of Theradras.  Destroy the tears and bring me the broken pieces!
Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Broken Tears to Warug in the Magram Village.
1419:
Have you spent many days in the Badlands, {class}?  Have you felt its heat? Have you faced the beasts that wander its dusty plains?  It's time you did.

Crag coyotes are a tough breed.  Tough, and bold enough to creep into Kargath and steal from our food supplies.  Help rid the outpost of these thieves!

Hunt crag coyotes, {name}.  Hunt them and bring me their jawbones.  Bring me enough, and maybe I'll believe it when you say you know the Badlands.
Bring 30 Coyote Jawbones to Neeka Bloodscar in Kargath.
1469:
Before the flight, I drank me a whole keg of stout. Hiccup!

And what a flight it was. Zipping around with Brohann following me. Didn't see no temple though. Hiccup!

Well, didn't see no temple till I got a little too tipsy and fell off my mount. I plunged right into the water and was sucked down. Found myself surrounded by a bunch of creepy trolls. Sure swam out of there fast! Even made off with this troll souvenir. Here, take it to Brohann and let him know his temple is down there, indeed. Hiccup!
Bring the Atal'ai Tablet Fragment to Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind.
2519:
A once great creature of the forest is in need of help, {race}.

There is a difficult task that must be done.

Please seek out Priestess A'moora; she will explain things to you. Find her to the southeast of here, inside the Temple of the Moon.
Sister Aquinne wants you to speak with Priestess A'moora in the Temple of the Moon.
2769:
Have you met the Brassbolts brothers?  They're over in the Shimmering Flats, in Kalimdor, racing their rocket car against the goblins.  They usually win which is no surprise--the goblin car blows up so much it barely ever crosses the finish line!

But even then, the Brassbolts brothers are always looking for new ways to make their car go faster, and Wizzle told me he needs a very rare component for his next experiment.

He probably needs help getting that part.  Speak to him and find out.
Speak with Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
2869:
The best course of action at this point is to assume that, regardless of what the naga are up to, they will eventually move to secure the island for their own.  We need to take aggressive steps to counter that threat before it is too late.

Bring me ten Hatecrest Scales that are in good condition; it should be obvious to you how to acquire them.  You'll cut your teeth on the naga for the first time, and we'll have a weakened naga presence on Sardor Isle - both are prospects that play to our advantage.
Bring 10 Hatecrest Naga Scales to Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.
2969:
The filthy Grimtotem clan are capturing faerie dragons, {name}. Jer'kai and I have no idea what they plan on doing with them, but they're obviously up to no good.

We're not powerful enough to fight our way into the camp and free the captured dragons, but perhaps with your help...

If you're willing, and you have some strong friends, release the creatures from their cage with this key and make sure they escape with their lives. I'll be by your side the entire time. Jer'kai will remain here.

Using the Bamboo Cage Key, free the Sprite Darters from the pen in the Grimtotem camp. At least 6 Sprite Darters and Kindal Moonweaver must survive.$B$BYou have 6 minutes before Kindal decides it is time to retreat and you fail the quest.
3369:
This shard holds great secrets; it is the pure essence of the Emerald Dream. However, what I see in this shard is not a dream; one would call this sort of a vision a nightmare.

I do not wish to alarm you, {name}, but I think it is best if you deliver this shard into the hands of a wise druid as soon as you can.

Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise is who you need to find. Head to Thunder Bluff. I cannot say more.
Bring the Nightmare Shard to Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise.
3519:
Ughhh... I was bitten very badly by a spider named Githyiss the Vile while exploring the spider cave very close to here. I am sure I have been seriously poisoned; you must help me.

Please tell Dirania Silvershine. She will be able to help me.

Hurry... I'm so dizzy...
Speak to Dirania Silvershine in Shadowglen.
3569: Give this to Thersa. Perhaps it will cure her... perhaps not. We really won't know until after she drinks it.
Give Cuely's Elixir to Thersa Windsong in Undercity.
4119: You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a night dragon plant.  The fruits that hang from the plant appear rotten and poisonous.  It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
4769:
Vivian Lagrave sent me word from Kargath, in the Badlands.  Through her studies, she believes there is an ancient text within Blackrock Spire that would benefit our research.  To confirm this, she will need someone to extract the text from the spire.  No easy task.

If interested, then speak with Vivian in Kargath.
5219:
One of the plague cauldrons is located in the field of a former farmhouse now referred to as Dalson's Tears.  Well, we shall shed no tears this day as we thwart the Scourge and have them choke on their own fumes!

Go to Dalson's Tears, almost due north of Andorhal, and eliminate the cauldron lord there.  It should have a key like the last one did, allowing you into the cauldron.  Use this bottle to obtain a sample from inside the cauldron; each cauldron has its own distinct brew of toxins it uses.

Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
5519: Need another suit, do ya?  Well, I'm not going anywhere soon it seems - bring me the same things I asked for from before, and I'll make you another ogre suit.
6569:
So the {race} wishes to become one of the Black Flight, eh?

The creation of the illusion you require is trivial, but the components required for the divination are quite difficult to obtain. Rexxar and the Warchief have entrusted you with this mission, so Myranda must assume you as capable.

Travel to the upper citadel of Blackrock Spire and slay enough of the black dragonspawn to fill up one of your packs with their eyes.

Return to Myranda when you have gathered enough of the reagent.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.
7169:
The base buzzes with news of your exploits in the Field of Strife! You have struck mighty blows against our enemy - crushing their morale! For this, you have earned a rank of honor among the Stormpike.

Present your insignia.
7819:
Greetings once again, {name}!  Our need for runecloth is constant, and we can always use additional resources if you are willing to part with them.  For an additional stack of twenty runecloth, I will make sure that you are recognized for your continuing efforts on behalf of the Undercity.

Whenever you are ready to hand in the stack of runecloth, I'll accept it.
8069:
The tribe acknowledges station and power through what we wear.  Our vestments are made from the finest of materials, and interwoven with the mojo we use to make us powerful.  Illusionists are no exception; their robes are said to embody the essence of illusion in their look.  Legend states that their ancient robes never looked the same twice.

I will give you an illusionist's robe, {name}... but earn your place of reverence among the tribe first!  Bring me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub!

Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Kossack.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.$B$BAl'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
8119:
<Maywiki points to your talisman.>

Look at it, {name}! It's come alive. The spirits dance around the orb.

Give it to Maywiki so she can make one last adjustment.
8169:
As you no doubt have heard, the League of Arathor is sending large numbers of troops into Arathi Basin.  Eager for food and supplies, these Alliance fools are intent to take and control the rich resources there.  We must show them that Arathi will never again be a home for humans!

Go to Arathi Basin and assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the stables.  Pull down the enemies' banners, declaring those territories for the Horde.

Go, {name}.  Report back to me when this task is complete.
Assault the Arathi Basin mine, lumber mill, blacksmith and stable, and then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.
8269: If you happen to have another Ribbons of Sacrifice for participating in the battle at Warsong Gulch, I will accept them on behalf of the Warsong Outriders.
Bring the Ribbons of Sacrifice to Sentinel Farsong so that the Sentinels may reward you for acting on our behalf.
8319: Keep bringing me texts.  We'll soon force the Twilight's Hammer out of Silithus.
8369: Listen up, {name}.  No matter what you might have heard about the battle raging in Alterac Valley, one thing remains true: the Stormpike Expedition invaded Frostwolf Territory.  The day we allow the Alliance to invade Horde lands without a forceful response is the day I hang up my axe and live the rest of my life in shame.  Go forth and expel the invaders!
Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
8469:
You've certainly earned my trust, {name}, but you may need to continue to earn the trust of my untrusting tribe.  There is something you can do to earn that trust.

The Winterfall are known to carry spirit beads to ward against foul spirits.  These beads have clearly failed in their purpose, as the Winterfall themselves are the agents of corruption.  Bring to me these spirit beads from fallen Winterfall furbolgs; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.

The Winterfall are known to carry spirit beads to ward against foul spirits. These beads have clearly failed in their purpose, as the Winterfall themselves are the agents of corruption. Bring to me these spirit beads from fallen Winterfall furbolgs; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.
8519: As you regain your composure and focus your gaze, you notice that something stirs within the crystal. Upon closer inspection, you realize that you are looking into the past... a memory... long forgotten.
Learn all that you can of the past, then speak with Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.$B
8669:
It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon.

Bring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!

Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of Strife, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
8919:
Hail, {class}!  I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world.  Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.

Perform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.

I'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus.  Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Dreadmist Bracers to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
8969:
Now we have what we need, so it's time to discuss who it is that you'll be summoning.

Kormok was ok for an ogre, right up until he turned to necromancy. After that, things got creepy for just about everyone in the outfit. It was no surprise then when he took his piece of the amulet and returned to his new home, Scholomance.

But even there, or perhaps especially there, he was not safe from the spectral assassins. They slew him right in front of his master, Ras Frostwhisper.
Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Kormok and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
9019:
Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together.  Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.

I, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Devout Sandals, Devout Skirt and Devout Mantle.
9069:
Would you honor me by returning the armor of those that fell in the defense of these lands?

The armor has been desecrated and is undoubtedly being used for evil; however, with wartorn armor scraps, the desecrated armor can be renewed and worn for battle once more.

Bring me the remnants of the fallen along with purification materials and Earthshatter shall be yours to don.

Search Naxxramas.

Rimblat Earthshatter at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Earthshatter Legguards if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Legguards, 20 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 3 Arcanite Bars and 5 Cured Rugged Hides.
9419:
We recently found out that the Horde has been scavenging the Silithus desert for resources, but paid them little mind. We thought it could not be worth it to station large numbers in this sweltering desert.

However, it was discovered the importance of the resources, and now we are scrambling to catch up.

If I have your assistance, you must go into the desert and recover the silithyst and return it here.
Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor, then speak with Marshal Bluewall at the Alliance encampment near Hive'Zora.
78919:
The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.  Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us.  If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.

{name}, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water.  In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity.  If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!
81769: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Warsong Lumber Camp. Defeat treants there and return to me.
81919:
I have fashioned a tool from the chain links you found. You might call it a "lasso" of sorts.
 
The energy within this chain is best suited for binding demons, but seeing as Calefactus may be from beyond the dark portal, I suspect it will work on him as well.

If you take him down bring me a sample of his fel lifeblood. Such an anomalous being warrants further study.

Calefactus' current location among these wastes is unknown, but I trust you'll track him down, {class}.
82019:
In its day the so-called Sunken Temple was home to a sect of trolls dedicated to the resurrection of their ancient blood deity, Hakkar the Soul-Flayer. Before the Atal'ai could realize their grim ambitions, Ysera's wrath smote the temple into the mire and she left the dragon Eranikus and his host as its guardians. Of late I have heard many whispers of trolls once again active there, and I fear what may have become of the dragons there.

Please, venture inside the temple and see what you can learn.
84169: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux.  I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin.  Bring me the belt and set of gloves that you wish to upgrade.  I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
84369:
Thank you, friend. I am in need of help, if you will assist me further.

My flask was stolen from me by the corrupted treants of Irontree Woods in Felwood. The herbal mixture should help with my wounds, but it will not be enough alone. Bring it to the hot springs of Winterspring. The healing waters there will aid in my recovery.
85619:
Your beliefs are alien to us, heathen.  Ancient Zandalar were once branded as heretics.  This was when the Gurubashi Empire was strong.  Heathens dared to challenge the priest of Hakkar.  Heathens then were hunted and killed as vermin.  Those heathens never wavered in their fight against the Blood God.  We honor the price they paid.  They are the freethinkers.

Destroy the minions of Hakkar in Zul'Gurub.  Bring me the Paragons of Power I seek.  Success will be greatly rewarded.

Go.
86969: I think I can fashion a magical totem of sorts that should allow you to pierce this malign darkness and at least allow you to explore the crypts. I don't have all of the components with me, however. Some of this might not be easy to find, but judging by what I've seen from you so far, I trust that you are resourceful enough to secure what is needed.
88969: Go to the Valley of Heroes and speak with Field Marshal Stonebridge.
90519:
I hate fish. I cannot stand the smell of them. They are extremely creepy. Truly the worst.

Since this is my kitchen, I can and do exercise my authority to say NO to fish imports, but sometimes our soldiers get it in their heads that they need a fisherman's feast.

Tonight is one of those nights it would seem. I need fish, on the double!
91569:
Listen kid, everyone out here's scramblin' for the same thing. Belgrom, the elves, the naga, they all wanna piece 'a that ancient highborne magic.

Me? Couldn't care less, but I know a seller's market when I see one.

I've seen blood elf arcanists carrying special wands. They're used to extract magical energy from artifacts the elves find. The arcanists stay at a camp east of the elves' base camp, along the cliffs. Get me one of those wands and I'll put you on to the score of a lifetime!
92069:
Two behemoths patrol the place the Blackmaw once called home: Bonesnout, the Unbroken and Withermaw, the great bear. Generations of hunters have tried to fell them, and all have failed.

I take no joy in asking you to slay these magnificent beasts, but my people need to be able to return home. The least I can do is ensure their deaths are not in vain. If you bring me their remains, I will fashion a weapon in memory of their strength.
92169:
The Blackthorne Pact. That's what they call themselves. Apostate druids that have taken over Hyjal Summit. Violent, and extremist. They blame Malfurion Stormrage for robbing them of their immortality, and have sworn to reclaim the power that they were forced to relinquish. I did not understand the magic that empowered them before, but it's becoming clear now.

Take the staff, use it on the Blackthorne druids around the mountain. It should respond to and dispel the wards protecting them.
92469:
You've done enough here, {class}. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
92519:
Apothecary Jorell was supposed to bring us a case of antidotes and elixirs days ago, but we're still empty handed. That fool has probably poisoned himself again by brewing in that poorly-ventilated shack he calls his lab.

If you want to further help our ward, you would be a far more reliable individual for this job.

Follow the road to Go'shek farm, south and a bit west of here. You'll likely find it packed and ready to go, with Jorell either missing or unconcerned with his obligations.
92819: We are almost finished. Use the detonator, and end this.
93269:
Now that you've recovered all the mail, you can take it all back with you to Mount Hyjal!

Should be no problem, right?
93319:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day-to-day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?
94219: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Draught of Water Breathing, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94269: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Inlaid Mithril Cylinder, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94319: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Draught of Detect Demon, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94369:
Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
94669:
First things first. I'm gonna need a deposit for your, uh... safety.

Look, I don't make the rules here. It's required.

Now if you should choose not to pay I'll be forced to tell old Clugfist our new friend wasn't so keen on proving their strength to our warm, welcoming friends here.

That would be a real shame. Catch my drift, bub?
94969:
Don't ask. You wouldn't believe me if I told you.

Let's just focus on getting me out of here! Oh, and you as well, of course.
95119:
You know the Eastsea crew? Real unsavory bunch, and that's coming from the guy running a place called "Powderfuse Port".

They're destructive, bloodthirsty, and, worst of all, cutting into my bottom line. They steal cargo, and sink ships, both of which end up costing me the big bucks!

We gotta take down their whole operation, starting with the ones closest to here. You can find 'em along the beaches to the north.
95219:
Got another job for ya, kiddo. How do you feel about traveling the world?

This here is some of the finest port you ever laid eyes on. Trouble is, it's gotta go quite the distance to one of my customers all the way over to Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. When you've reached trees taller than you've ever seen before, you know you've reached the spot.

One of my guys packed it airtight but there's no telling what might set it off, so handle with care, okay bub?
95319:
Listen, I know you can smell the fel blood pools behind me and I'm sure you've seen the crystals that grow out of them. These crystals have special properties from the ashes of Archimonde that rain down on this side of the hill.

Something about how they are formed makes them especially good at draining fel energies, which is a big problem for someone like me, but they can still have their uses.

I want you to gather some for me. Try and get a few kinds. I'll know what I need when I see it.
95569:
The owls are under threat by the fel corruption that afflicts the mountainside, and the creatures poisoned and enraged by those energies. Many owls have abandoned their nests for safer places higher up the mountain. Others have fallen in defense of their young.

For the owls to have a future, their eggs must be protected and their fledglings nurtured. Bring the abandoned eggs to me. You may find eggs in abandoned nests at the base of trees north and east of here.
95769:
Every day be a challenge when you living rough like we do! Takes a toll on your tools, your clothes, your whole life. Good thing it can't take our spirit!

We be really hurting from our clothes and blankets wearing out. You do some tailoring, right? So maybe you can bring me some Bolts of Runecloth and I can fix a few holes?
95819:
Greetings, accomplished craftsperson!

Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth!

Once completed, please bring this to your local Durotar Supply & Logistics Contract Coordinator to begin processing.

Happy crafting!
96369: <The King is dead--killed in an escape attempt just before the Naga attacked. Many Kor'kron died to learn this news, but this knowledge could shake the Alliance to its core. You need to return to Commander Folkar and tell him what you've learned as quickly as possible.>
96769:
Quel'Shalla. That is the name the magic whispers to me. I can only assume it was made for an influential sentinel, or warden. I wonder if perhaps...

<Lydros reaches out and his fingers idly brush the blade as he speaks. As soon as his skin touches the metal, he freezes.>

Wait...

No... wait... there is something else here. Darkness. I... I cannot continue. Please, take the blade from my sight at once!
96919: This time it's gonna be every gob for himself! Get yourself over to the Gurubashi Arena and make Kha'damu proud!
97119:
In addition to seeing to the spiritual needs of the people here, I feed them as well. I'm not exactly a trained cook, but after five years, I've learned a thing or two about preparing food!

I'm sure that folks here would love a taste of something different. I remember, before we assembled on the mountain, there was a goblin from Everlook who was serving platters of tiny, Savory Stag Sliders... I would love to taste one of those again. We have plenty of stags up here, too! Think you can cook some up?
97269:
I am really quite busy right now, if you could please move along.

Wait... that glaive you carry... could it be? Bring it closer into the light so that I may study it further!
97319:
A cousin of mine on Kalimdor has been cutting his way through the most dangerous sites there and, last I heard, is on his way to Mount Hyjal.

This seems like a ridiculous waste of time.

If you ever find yourself out in that part of the world, it would be good to know that he hasn't gotten himself killed. Yet.
98069:
Those wretched harpies! They attacked the last caravan I had scheduled to deliver supplies to Freewind Post. We have enough supplies for the moment, but without more supplies, we'll run short soon.

I'm not sure what the harpies plan to do with the extra supplies, but I would be grateful if you would recover them for me. They make their lair west of here. They can be found both at the base of the cliffside and inside a cave at the top.
98219:
Thank you again for delivering the statuette safely, {name}.

I could use your help with something else. There's a member of the city guard who was reassigned to duty in Southshore out in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

His father was a friend of mine, and while I don't disagree that he could use the lesson... I'd still like to see him succeed. He would really benefit from someone like you helping him out.

There is a boat that can take you that way from Menethil Harbor, if you are passing back through.
98319:
It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here.

If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid.

Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some of the beasts while yer at it.
98919:
It not be enough to just defeat the Alliance. We must be demoralizing them to drive them from the Darkspear Islands for good. Return to Darkspear Islands and show them no mercy. Win in the battle while controlling at least three outposts.

Crush the Alliance and claim big victory for the Darkspear Raiders!
98969:
This was once a helm of sorts, though it is difficult to tell it now in its twisted form. We can restore it, however. Like all things, there is a cost to this.

Go to the bastion of Blackrock Spire and claim the left eye of the false warchief, Rend Blackhand. From there, reach the pinnacle of the stronghold and claim the right eye of General Drakkisath, chief agent of the Lord of Blackrock.

Do this and you will remove two great evils from the world. Then I will cleanse the artifact you hold.
99019:
There's power in a creature's heart. It's the core of one's life, and without it, the living cease to live. I sometimes miss the beating of my own heart, though I acknowledge that requiring a pulse to live is... strictly a liability.

Travel to the Shaper's Terrace overlooking Un'goro Crater and retrieve the still-beating heart of the great Direhorn Matriarch there, as well as the hardened heart of the watcher, Nanaya.

Do this and I will cleanse the armor piece you carry.
